# Let me create some test inputs to try
import os
import subprocess

# Test various inputs
test_cases = [
    b"$",           # just dollar sign
    b"${",          # dollar open brace
    b"${:",         # dollar open brace colon
    b"${:}",        # dollar open brace colon close
    b"${}",         # empty variable
    b"a$",          # string ending with dollar
    b"a${",         # string with incomplete variable
    b"a${:}",       # string with variable default
    b"a${b}",       # string with variable
    b"#",           # just comment
    b"'''",         # just multiline string start
    b"'''\n'''",    # multiline string
    b"a\n",         # simple string with newline
    b"a=",          # key-value
    b"a={}",        # section shorthand
    b"{",           # just open bracket
    b"}",           # just close bracket
    b"a\n$",        # string followed by dollar on new line
    b"a\n${",       # string followed by incomplete variable
    b"\n",          # just newline
    b"",            # empty
    b"a$b",         # dollar in middle of string
    b"a${b}c",      # variable in middle of string
    b"a${:default}c", # variable with default in middle
    b"a\n$b",       # dollar not followed by brace
    b"a\n${b}",     # variable on new line
]

for i, tc in enumerate(test_cases):
    with open(f"/tmp/test_input_{i}", "wb") as f:
        f.write(tc)

for i in range(len(test_cases)):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["/tmp/config_fuzzer_harness", f"/tmp/test_input_{i}"],
        capture_output=True, timeout=5
    )
    print(f"Test {i} ({test_cases[i]!r}): exit={result.returncode}, stderr={result.stderr.decode()[:100]}")
